[D13:1] John: Hey Maria! Long time no see! Tons has gone down since then!

[D13:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people standing around a table filled with food

[D13:8] Maria: Wow, John! You and your family are awesome for staying consistent and motivated to create healthy habits. Seeing that kind of dedication is inspiring! Keep it up!

[D13:10] Maria: You're really inspiring with your commitment. Keep motivating each other!
